messages:
Elena (CEO): Quick weekly founders check-in — short read. Highlights and asks below. TL;DR: Private GA momentum, small Friday incident, cost progress, policy tweak for hosted defaults. More below :sparkles:

Elena (CEO): 1) Private GA: two pilot customers finished pilot testing. One signed an LOI for Dedicated capacity. We are moving to a staged GA next week with canary routing enabled. Please treat that as high priority for sales/success readiness. :rocket:

Elena (CEO): 2) Reliability recap: Friday ~09:22 PT we saw a regional latency spike (~9 min) affecting hosted inference. Cause: autoscaler race when nodes cycled while batcher inflight => temporary queueing. Mitigation: reverted aggressive scale-down, patched autoscaler to wait-for-quiesce. No customer data loss. Full postmortem & timeline scheduled. :white_check_mark:

Elena (CEO): 3) Cost: unit token cost down ~12% MoM after the continuous-batcher kernel change. Ops target is -20% by EOW with caching + quantization suggestions from Optimize. Keep incremental wins coming.

Elena (CEO): 4) Policy change (hosted only): default data retention for free / self-serve orgs will move from 90d -> 30d to reduce storage and compliance risk. Enterprise/Dedicated/Private customers keep org-level overrides. Security will publish the FAQ and a customer comms template. @security / @sales heads, please review before we ship. :memo:

Elena (CEO): Asks:
- Eng: prioritize rollback-safe canary for model routing and a formal fallback policy (important for GA).
- SRE: finish incident postmortem with clear mitigations and ops playbook.
- Product: freeze API surface additions for 10 days around GA window.
- People Ops: schedule a brief all-hands to walk through policy change and GA plan.

Maya (VP Eng): +1 on canary work. We pushed the autoscaler hotfix Friday night and rolled it to prod. Will carve out 2 sprint days to build a verified rollback path and automated verification checks.

Diego (Head SRE): Postmortem scheduled Mon 10:00am PT (calendar invite sent to #incidents and leads). Timeline + mitigations are in the incident doc: https://console.redwood.ai/incident/3765432100 — please add any log captures you think matter. We'll also add an SLO test to the weekly chaos run. :mag:

Priya (VP Product): Copy — product freeze acknowledged. We'll gate any change behind a QA sign-off and a release checklist that includes rollback verified. I'll draft customer-facing notes for GA + retention changes and circulate by EOD tomorrow.

Sam (CFO): Congrats on LOI. Sam question: what's the projected ARR if both pilots convert at committed levels? Need a quick topline for board prep by Tue. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Elena (CEO): Sam — initial back-of-envelope is ~$600k ARR if both customers convert at committed minimums. I'll get more precise numbers from Sales Ops and share before Tue EOD.

Alex (People Ops): Scheduling note: quick all-hands Wed 11:00am PT to walk through retention policy and GA expectations. Will post agenda and Q&A doc. :calendar:

Riley (Engineer): Can we add a per-org feature-flag for retention defaults so we can flip for pilots if they ask? Saves urgent one-off changes.

Elena (CEO): Yes — per-org override is allowed for Enterprise & Dedicated. Hosted default change will not break existing orgs if they have explicit settings. Security will own the enforcement and will publish the migration plan.

deploy-bot: deploy finished: infra/autoscaler-hotfix @ production — 3765432199 :robot_face:

Maya (VP Eng): Noted. After the canary work, we'll add an automated smoke that validates end-to-end latency and batcher queue length before traffic ramp.

Diego (Head SRE): We'll put the incident checklist in the runbook and add a post-deploy validation step to reduce blast radius.

Priya (VP Product): I'll handle customer comms draft and coordinate with Sales. We'll highlight: GA timeline, retention defaults, and how to request per-org settings.

Elena (CEO): Thank you team. Small, focused week — main objectives: ship canary + postmortem + customer comms. If anything blocks these, ping me directly. :eyes:

Elena (CEO): Closing note — celebrate the cost improvement (team win) and keep the velocity disciplined for GA.

Alex (People Ops): Will send calendar + short pre-read.

Sam (CFO): I'll expect the ARR numbers Tue AM. Thanks.

Riley (Engineer): Thx — will add feature-flag RFC today.

Elena (CEO): End of thread.
